experiment: Re-grounded deployment comparison on REAL LongBench F1 (b0.20, chat, 48 prompts)
finding: On REAL task quality all selectors are statistically tied (within ~0.02-0.03); H2O is NOT best (lowest on qasper). The eps ordering (H2O best, GuardKV worst) does NOT hold on task quality. Re-grounds the deployment story: selector choice barely affects task quality at 20% budget; the eps-based H2O-best conclusion was a proxy artifact.
